# ScrollAlign

`Flare.Components.ScrollAlign`

Where a scrolled-to element should come to rest in the visible area.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Nearest` | `0` | Whichever edge is closer - scrolls the least. |
| `Start` | `1` | Against the start edge. |
| `Center` | `2` | Centred. |
| `End` | `3` | Against the end edge. |
